Results.ReviewText: We bought our grill 2 years ago, but with extenuating circumstances, we haven't used it very much. During a windstorm it blew off of our deck and parts everywhere. The door broke off and we were missing pieces. I wrote to Weber and they sent us new pieces immediately at no cost to us. Their customer service is number one in my book. I would recommend them to anyone. They really stand behind their product.
Results.Title: Customer Service

Results.ReviewText: After having our last Weber for 25 years it's no wonder we bought another one. Of course we upgraded to this one. My hubby grills almost every night. He swears this one is so simple to use with the push of a button it's on. He also love the look of it with the tank underneath. It cooks to perfection and clean up is a breeze. We both love it.
Results.Title: Grilling is a breeze.

Results.ReviewText: ACE is the place. Ace assembled and delivered right to my patio. Assembly was complete and well done.

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill because it was enclosed on the bottom, reducing insects and wildlife from entering the base and drafts affecting the flame. We do not have a wall to put this grill against. Upon putting it together we were disappointed that it did not have the back enclosed as the model on the floor showed and models before ours had.  We called Weber and were told the "Innovation Team" suggested this change to grills manufactured this year.  It does not make sense to have an enclosed front with the back open.  Your "Innovation Team" should revisit their decision.  Otherwise the grill works great.
Results.Title: Updated design that we were unaware of

Results.ReviewText: Works well enough but I wouldn't say it's worth it for the extra price of buying a Weber. I had a Coleman grill before that was about half the price but I upgraded thinking that Weber would be better. But there is no noticeable difference for the increase in price I paid to get a Weber. Despite consistently cleaning the grill and its components the whole thing still flames up frequently, does not cook evenly across all parts of the grill, and required several new parts after only two summers of use.
Results.Title: Okay Grill But Not Worth the Price

Results.ReviewText: This grill is easy to use and makes more efficient use of the propane fuel than my previous Weber charcoal grill. It’s nice to be able to accurately measure temperatures; I only wish that the side tables folded down when the grill isn’t in use. I’m still getting used to grilling with propane, so I need to get a better grasp on grilling fish and indirect grilling. So much easier and cleaner than dealing with charcoal!
Results.Title: Switching to propane

Results.ReviewText: Over the years I have owned many Weber grills,(charcoal and gas) and the company’s commitment to quality and innovation is no surprise to me. When I need a new grill, or someone asks my opinion about a grill, I always recommend Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Love E-310 gas grill, but, needs a back panel badly!  We live outside of town where raccoons are present, with only a small like 9" back panel on the lower back of the grill, the drip tray and any drippings is right in the open inviting animals.  I feel they may mess up the ignition wires, leave germs, hair, etc.  Grill is too heavy to pull into garage each use, especially on the little, plastic caster  wheels.  Call to Weber got me nowhere.  I need the back to be enclosed, is plenty of ventilation as both side panels have it.

Results.ReviewText:
I bought my grill on April 9 & they delivered it & set it up on April 12. Two weeks later I tried to grill on it and there was a leak in the hose & regulator kit when I opened the propane tank. I called 1 800 446 1071 & waited 30 minutes before someone picked up. I told her my problem, & she put me on hold.
She never got back to me. I called the Ace Hdware store where I bought it & Mike, the mgr., said he 
would contact the Missouri rep. about getting the part. Mike called him on May 4, & he never returned his call. Today, May 7, Mike called the Illinois rep, who said he would take care of getting me the part.
Results.Title: Disgusted with Weber Grill Co.

Results.ReviewText: I owned a Weber Genesis Silver for 25 years & other than replacing the grates & the flavor bars, it was a trouble free grill. Thats why I decided to purchase another Weber grill. This grill has been working great although I've only used it 4 or 5 times now.
Results.Title: Great little grill. Its been working super so far.

Results.ReviewText: Great value on a premium quality grill. The components from initial uses seem to be made much better than some of the more value priced competitors. I've had a few "cheaper" grills and have had to replace components and should have just jumped right into a better made grill instead of replacing multiple cheap grills. I went with the basic E-310 since I don't need side burners or the extra burner. It's very easy to control the temperature for easier cooking and making sure you get your food cooked to perfection. Simple to use and really like the storage. Definitely do not regret spending extra for this versus a budget grill.
Results.Title: Good Value Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great build quality, Heats up in mintues to 500F and grills evenly, very satisfied with this purchase, best bbq and great value for a Weber grill!!
Results.Title: Happy Customer

Results.ReviewText: Purchased my first Weber after a very positive experience using one while on vacation. No flare ups and even distribution of heat across the grill.
Results.Title: My First Weber

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
